rationale: After 88 minutes in the trade, the downside continuation thesis has failed to materialize as price has reclaimed both the 5-minute 9-EMA ($12.81) and session VWAP ($12.88). Concurrently, the broader market has recovered over half of its losses since entry (SPY moving from -1.02% to -0.50%), providing a tailwind that is pushing EQPT steadily higher on the 1-minute tape. Exiting here cuts the trade for a minor loss before it runs into the $13.05 stop, while avoiding a flip to long against severe negative fundamental news.
